The stage was set for a historic encounter on August 16, 2026 , as Arsenal and Manchester City faced off in the CAF Super Cup . Fans gathered in their thousands, anticipating a clash of titans where tactical discipline would meet individual brilliance under the bright lights of a major final. A Lightning Start for the Gunners Arsenal wasted no time in asserting their dominance, finding the back of the net in the very first minute. Riccardo Calafiori showcased his attacking instincts, slotting home a left-footed strike following a precise setup by Myles Lewis-Skelly . A tense VAR review briefly halted celebrations, but the goal was officially confirmed in the 3rd minute. The momentum remained firmly with the London side, and in the 28th minute, a sweeping team move culminated in Kai Havertz heading home a cross from Christos Tzolis to double the lead. Despite the cushion, the first half was not without drama. Riccardo Calafiori was booked for simulation in the penalty area, a controversial call that sparked heated debates on the pitch. Manchester City searched for a lifeline, and Jeremy Doku nearly provided it, only to see his goal-bound effort heroically cleared off the line. Just before the break, Martin Oedegaard almost capitalized on a defensive lapse by Gianluigi Donnarumma , but the ball was once again hacked away from danger at the last second. Sealing the Triumph in Style Any hopes of a Manchester City comeback were dashed shortly after the restart. In the 48th minute, Martin Oedegaard turned from provider to scorer, finishing clinically with his left foot after excellent work from Christos Tzolis . Leading by three, Arsenal managed the game with maturity. Tactical substitutions saw the likes of Declan Rice and Bukayo Saka enter the fray, ensuring that the defensive shape remained unbreakable against the mounting pressure from the opposition. As the clock ticked toward full-time, the City attack, led by late substitutes Rayan Cherki and Antoine Semenyo , forced David Raya and his defenders into action. Gabriel and Martin Zubimendi produced vital blocks and clearances to maintain the clean sheet. When the final whistle blew in front of 58,056 spectators, it confirmed a comprehensive victory for Arsenal . The Gunners' clinical finishing and defensive resilience earned them the CAF Super Cup trophy in a night to remember.
